Definition: to set (literally or figuratively); intensively, to found; reflexively, to sit down together, i.e. settle, consult
BiblicalUsage: 1) to found, fix, establish, lay foundation; 1a) (Qal) to found, establish, begin; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to fix or seat themselves close together, sit in conclave; 1b2) to be founded; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to found; 1c2) to establish, appoint, ordain; 1d) (Pual) to be founded, be laid; 1e) (Hophal) to be founded
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
